name: feature.promotions.agents
description: Promotions feature agent pack — a Promotions Manager persona whose tools are registered chat tools over the promotions service (the same fns the REST routes call). Reviews promotions (active + proposed), previews cart discounts, and DRAFTS promotions — which land PROPOSED (inactive) for human activation (money-moving). There is no activate tool — confirmation rides the human gate. Tool-allowlisted to the promotions surface only. Driven through the ONE chat.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Promotions Manager
agents.description: Reviews active promotions, previews the discount on a cart, and drafts new promotions (cart-threshold / product-discount / loss-leader) — drafts land PROPOSED for a human to activate, via feature.promotions.nodes over ctx.features.promotions.
